title: Laundry Technician for Lonavala
description:
**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Operate, monitor, and maintain industrial laundry equipment including washing machines, dryers, presses, steam irons, and finishing equipment.
   

  

 Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of laundry machinery to ensure smooth operations.
   

  

 Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, and operational faults in laundry equipment.
   

  

 Ensure proper functioning of boilers, steam lines, pumps, and related laundry systems.
   

  

 Conduct regular inspection, lubrication, cleaning, and servicing of machines.
   

  

 Attend breakdowns promptly and minimize equipment downtime.
   

  

 Maintain maintenance records, machine checklists, and service reports.
   

  

 Coordinate with the Housekeeping/Laundry team to ensure uninterrupted laundry operations.
   

  

 Follow hotel safety, hygiene, fire\-safety, and engineering standards at all times.
   

  

 Coordinate with external vendors/service agencies for major repairs and equipment servicing.
   

  

**Job Expectations**
 Key Skills
   

  

 Strong knowledge of industrial laundry equipment
   

  

 Electrical \& mechanical troubleshooting
   

  

 Preventive maintenance
   

  

 Knowledge of steam/boiler systems
   

  

 Safety and maintenance standards
   

  

 Ability to respond quickly to equipment breakdowns
   

  

**Minimum Qualification**
 ITI/Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
   

  

**Minimum Job Experience**
 2–5 years of experience as a Laundry Technician
   

  

**Reporting To**
 Laundry Manager
   

  

**Travel**
 N/A Apply Now
